author: Priya Shah
rule: Avoid inline CSS; use Tailwind utility classes instead.
rationale: The design system is maintained through reusable Tailwind tokens, so inline styles create inconsistent UI and make themes harder to update.

author: Arjun Rao
rule: Validate and null-check every API parameter before using it in business logic.
rationale: A missing request value previously caused a production 500 instead of a clear 400 response.

author: Meera Nair
rule: Route handlers must use the service layer and must not query the database directly.
rationale: Keeping database access in services preserves transaction handling, authorization checks, and testability.

author: Karthik Iyer
rule: Never log raw passwords, authentication tokens, or API keys, including in debug statements.
rationale: Logs are retained and searchable; credentials must be redacted before any logging.
